about: HS-058.15 (Owners, 23 Nov 2026) · the product photographs and short lines of the Pre-Wedding Dinner menu selection in My Profile (assets/pre-wedding-dinner.js · LOOK). Every photograph is cut from the restaurant's ORIGINAL menu "Menu Cam On.pdf" (20 pages, each page one 4961 x 7016 JPEG at 600 ppi; the web copy is assets/pdf/cam-on-menu.pdf): nothing generated, nothing from stock. A photograph is assigned to a code by the code's label beside it, the Lao and English names and what the photograph shows. box900 = [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the page scaled to 900 px wide (x 4961/900 for the original); a "p+q" page is a two-page spread. paintedOut900: the menu's own lettering or a neighbour's edge covered with the flat page ground beside it, never on the dish. Food 4:3, drinks 4:5; WebP q74 at 400 and 800 px wide in assets/images/pre-wedding-dinner/menu/.
